notes.title: A Promise Best Left Unkept - Aya Edition V0.9.3 is now LIVE!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/0f3bf231dce92c7ac90f622d18e31c7cd67fd799.png"][/img]Hi![/p][p]Next month is going to be the official release of the game. It's been hard, having all the animations/illustrations ready in such a short span of time, but let's hope I'm going to make it. Anyway, let's get this out of the way.[/p][p]Here are the things added:[/p][p align="start"]+ 24.2k word (total: 466.4k words)[/p][p align="start"]+ 8 CG sets (total: 125 CGs)[/p][p align="start"]+ 3 lewd scenes (total: 68 lewd scenes)[/p][p align="start"]I feel like I have quite a few things to say, but I don't want to waste more time before releasing this. I mentioned it before, but this ending (because this update does reach an ending) wasn't planned. I wrote it because I thought about it on the spot, and found it funny. The plan was to release the other ending from this path first, so that even if this one fail, it would be fine. But the other endings had more animations, and as you can see, I'm already very slow with those. So I was forced to go with this ending first. I don't think it’s very good. It also cost a lot for how bad it is. But whatever. We had to get through it at some point. I guess that point is today.[/p][p align="start"]You might observe that some moments could have had a CGs. Those moments, while not important, were supposed to have CGs. But I'm a retarded person who doesn't really think about budget or time when writing. If I had done those as well, we would be at like 12 CGs, most of them not even that interesting. Anyway! Don't want to spoil or say things that I shouldn't so I will just stop.[/p][p align="start"]Next update, I might have the same kind of problem. Not necessarily the animations, but maybe the illustrations. I'm currently paying my artist more so he can draw faster, but yeah… this is tight. It's kind of my fault for wanting to complete the game for November, but we've been in this development cycle for long enough, I think.[/p][p align="start"]In any case, no commentaries. Don't feel like doing those.[/p][p align="start"]Have a nice end of the week.[/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/c8fb9070665b3e10b8d504b14a5f5b2192ea381b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey guys.[/p][p align="start"]I'm not feeling all that well, but that's life, I guess.[/p][p align="start"]It's hard to tell if this update is any good. My focus has been a bit elsewhere, so hopefully I did an okay job coding this.[/p][p align="start"]Here are the new things added:[/p][p align="start"]- 20k~ words (total: 442k words)[/p][p align="start"]- 8 CG sets (total: 117 CGs)[/p][p align="start"]- 4 Lewd scenes (total: 65 lewd scenes)[/p][p align="start"]The number of lewd scenes is debatable, so I put four. But as you can see there's more action as we get closer to an ending. I'm really not sure if I'll be able to have all the CGs/animations ready for next month. Even for this update, I was forced to pick and choose, pretty much. I want to complete this game for November, so we'll see what happens. This is kind of an annoying situation.[/p][p align="start"]I don't have much to say. I feel like I forgot a few things, but I can't afford to wait longer before releasing this.[/p]

notes.title: V0.8.6 Just Came Out!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/377e43af53db91ebb7625c62d0c1a9c52023ef47.jpg"][/img]Here we go again, for more Aya fun time! We're starting a new route today, this is exciting.[/p][p]Here's what's new:[/p][p]- 18k words (total: 422k words)[/p][p]- 4 CG sets (total: 109 CGs)[/p][p]- 2 Lewd scenes (total: 61 lewd scenes)[/p][p]So yeah, we're starting a new path. In order to reach it, you simply need to choose "The Convenience Store" when looking for Aya. The previous choice doesn't matter. This choice overrides it.[/p][p]If you use the Jump To Version menu in the extra section, you will jump right at the choice. You will be forced to see one scene that is almost exactly the same from Aya perspective, but then you will fully enter the new path.[/p][p]The update is slightly smaller than I would like, but since the endings have more sex scenes, and thus more animations. I'm hoping to release a bigger update next month (believe me, I want to finish this soon).[/p][p]I don't have much to say about this update. I have not written a commentary for Aya Edition this month, I've been too busy trying to add features to my site. Now you can leave a review for specific builds. I've been busier, trying to keep up with three monthly releases, plus The Edge of… so yeah. I like doing commentaries, but I won't force it.[/p][p]For the Simplified Chinese, the beginning of the path is not translated. But if you skip further away, most of it is translated. It's just that I forgot that some events were changed from previous files (due to the shift in path). I apologize for that. It will be fixed next month.[/p]

notes.title: V0.8.3 is now Live (First Ending Reached)!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/3a82c3d6661d925f12f6339021162782dc627f18.jpg[/img]

It took more time than expected, but here we are. The first ending of Aya Edition. Let's get this out of the way, V0.8.3 adds:

- 14340 words (total: 404k words)

- 6 CG sets (total: 105 CGs)

- 3 Lew scenes (total: 59 lewd scenes)

Although this is the first ending, it doesn't really feel that way. Compared to the original, Aya Edition, I think, was stronger during the corruption phase. I feel like the endings will be inferior to the original. Though that's kind of hard for me to evaluate, really. Sorry for always being negative. I know it's not the way you want to go about reading the update.

In any case, you will notice that there are quite a few animations… That's because the action usually ramps up toward the end. I sincerely hope that it doesn't mess with my schedule, but if I need four animations for an update… I might have a hard time with the current animators that I have. Just something to keep in mind.

I don't have much to say about the content of this update. As you can see, the game is already 404k words (with the common route). That's… a lot more than I thought this game was going to be. We still have three endings left after this one, around 100k words to go. Hopefully, we conclude this game in something like 6 months…?

Something in this update did make me… feel a bit sad. I talk a bit about it in the commentaries. Can't really mention it now though.

I will also raise the price of the game by a few dollars. There's enough content in the game at this point that I feel like it's the right time to do so.

notes.title: V0.8.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/f46c8e9a1b698219cbc21c709e35342e105737c5.jpg[/img]

Hey.

Before I talk about this update, I just want to announce that there won't be an update next month. My artist needed this month to recuperate. This isn't something I wanted to happen, but we're there anyway. 

Since we've started an ending, I need more CGs, which means that… I couldn't even make this update as long as I would have liked it to. And I also had to give up on one CG.

This ending, all in all, is around 34k words, which means that halved in two… makes for a small update.

The content: 14113 words added, 6 CG sets, and, like, 3 lewd scenes.

My thoughts are a bit of a mess right now, so I don't know what I should even say. I have worries, as usual. Some will like this ending, others won't.

So, no update for Aya Edition next month. 

In any case, take care of yourself.

Story[/b]

notes.title: A Promise Best Left Unkept - Aya Edition V0.7.6 is now AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/a9839aa951885d50a1b6e7249c12d81ee39c9e98.png[/img]

Alright, so this is it. I don't know how to feel about this update. I knew we would have to tackle it at some point, but it was always far away in my mind.

First of all, for the things that were added. 21k words~, 6 CG sets, and 1 sex scene. I know, 1 sex scene sounds low when we're at this point in the story, but it is how it is.

Now, it will sound kind of hollow coming from me since I say it pretty much every single time. But this worries me. I tried my best to think of a way to avoid what's happening in this update… but it's not possible. This is the problem with Aya, pretty much. I never thought she was compatible with NTR, and this update encapsulates the reason why perfectly. I won't say more about it until after everyone had the chance to play the update, but that's just my personal opinion and I want to share it.

I also feel let down by how the sex scene ended up looking like. I wanted to animate it, but it would have cost too much. Also, the direction could have been better. I tried something, but I think it didn’t work all that well.

Other important scenes are also suffering from bad direction, I feel like. I know it's a visual novel, and there's a limit to how I can portray things, but it still doesn't mean I can't be disappointed by it. In my head, I had a very clear image of what I wanted to show… but it lacks something. It's hard to put into words.

In any case! I know me, whining, is stupid. I should be building up hype, not shooting it with a shotgun. So I'll stop here. Depending on people's reactions, I'll post something more thorough in the next couple of weeks explaining my thoughts on the matter. For now, happy disappointment!

notes.title: V0.7.3 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/08e524616e688182200b57b0596c7cad2ddd51d8.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone!

V0.7.3 adds 20700~ words to the story, 4 CG sets, and 2 sex scenes. It also adds the first choice, although, as of right now, you can only choose one option out of the two. Like the development of the original, we're going about it in a linear order. So one ending at a time. Would be too complicated to have multiple endings developing at the same time.

Next month will be the last update before we start the first ending. So we're getting dangerously close to the end of the game. Well, I say relatively because, while we will be starting the first ending, it will still take about two updates to complete it, and we have three more endings after that one… so yeah. If everything goes well, we should complete Aya Edition either in October or November.

I've… also been losing a bit too much time on the commentaries. I know how much you love those retarded bits, so of course I'm going to waste multiple hours on them. Seriously though, I… love to give myself a headache.

In any case, I was in a hurry to release the update, and so I haven't looked at the text as much as I would have liked it. Let's cross our fingers and pray I didn't blunder.

notes.title: V0.7.0 has finally released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/b972c81f0659df2bd6c4edd09fe19a55f6bc6bcd.png[/img]

We're finally back to our usual monthly releases. Hopefully, this won't happen often. I'm able to release this early in the month mainly because I worked on the update in November.

While November wasn't a break per se, it still wasn't enough to give me a chance to release a bigger update. This update is pretty much the same length as the other one. It's a bit more than 20k words, it adds 6 CG sets and 3 lewd scenes. I mainly needed more time because there were a bit more animations this time around. This can really mess up my schedule.

As for the content of the update, there are a lot of things I would like to say about it. I made a few mistakes, I also feel like things are moving fast… but this is kind of ridiculous when you think about it. We're 300k words deep in the story. Almost no NTR games are this long. And we still have around 10 months worth of updates to go. So yeah… hope you guys enjoy it…

notes.title: V0.6.6 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867422/422fa6b61f5f4547b75512433aa5f1b4f15e2670.jpg[/img]

V0.6.6 is more of a transitional update. It doesn't have as much action as I would like it to, but it's important story-wise.

As for the actual content, about 27k words have been added, 3 CG sets, and two-ish lewd scene. One thing I need to make clear is that I have been having a hard time with the animations these days. In fact, the scene from last month that missed an animation is still not animated. I'll make sure to animate it before the next update, so yeah… that's kinda frustrating.

Something I realized is that with working with three projects at the same time, the thing that is taking a hit is the coding/direction. I feel like I've been lazier and lazier with the way I direct the scenes. I don't know if it's noticeable or not, but I'm not quite satisfied with this update. Maybe I'm just thinking too much, but if you guys notice it, I would like to know.

I've also been lazy with testing the game for bugs, so do let me know if you find some.

One last thing, but I'm on a break right now. Been a while since I took anything resembling a break. Although it's mainly because I'm waiting for my animator. So don't expect an update next month. The next update should release here more in January. Sorry about that.

In any case, the next update should have more juicy scenes, I promise. We're slowly getting closer to the endings and so things should ramp up pretty fast.

notes.title: A Promise Best Left Unkept – Aya Edition v0.3.0 released on Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a few months since I started working on the alternative version of A Promise Best Left Unkept, A Promise Best Left Unkept – Aya Edition, and I feel like it has enough content to be released on Early Access. 

Aya Edition is a version of A Promise Best Left Unkept where Aya becomes the main heroine. You don't need to have played the original version as the two games share the same beginning. And so, for those who have already played the original version, you can easily skip the beginning by choosing the 'skip the common route' option when starting a new game.

Here are a few of the features available as of V0.3.0 (not counting the common route):
-	More than 25 CG sets 
-	More than 8 sex scenes
-	More than 100k words
-	Most of the sex scenes are animated.

I'm planning to update it every month as this is my main project.

I hope you have fun reading Aya and Harry's tumultuous relationship… because it's only going to get worse.

[url=https://discord.gg/JPb34QCrnu]For more info on my other projects, or simply to become part of my community, don't forget to become a member of my discord server![/url]
